children: Laredo Oil, Inc. reported a fiscal 2026 net loss of $7.97M on revenue of $3.1K, a sharp decline in top-line receipts and a wider loss versus fiscal 2025 that produced a net loss of $3.18M. Diluted loss per share widened to $(0.10) from $(0.04) a year earlier.
Revenue was $3.1K for FY 2026, down from $9.4K in FY 2025 ( (66.6%)).
Net income (loss) was a loss of $7.972M for FY 2026, versus a loss of $3.182M in FY 2025 (loss widened).
Diluted EPS was $(0.10) for FY 2026, versus $(0.04) for FY 2025 (diluted loss per share widened).
Revenue recognition was minimal, with only roughly $3K of oil and gas revenue in FY 2026; operating losses were driven by higher operating expenses and impairments.

The company has shifted operational focus toward developing Underground Gravity Drainage (UGD) internationally and is conducting due diligence in Argentina, Mexico, the MENA region, Romania, Albania and Azerbaijan.
Domestically, Laredo is pursuing UGD‑compatible acreage in Texas and evaluating Montana assets: the Midfork well was sold, while the Olfert and Lustre wells are under review or shut‑in.
Texakoma‑funded activity included three drilled wells (Laredo carried a 15% working interest); eight additional wells remain paused pending economics and further field evaluation.
